# Contract: thumbnail-ab

Third-party skill from [xianyu110/ecommerce-video-skills](https://github.com/xianyu110/ecommerce-video-skills) (MIT, xianyu110), `96c49b3`. SumitCraft set the folder name and the description so the skill fills one gap (Thumbnail and cover stills with title variants). The method is upstream. Category: video. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Make several cover stills and short title variants from a finished video, plus a comparison sheet.

## Use it for
- "make thumbnail options for this video"
- "A/B test a cover still"

## Not for
- generate a new illustration (image-gen)
- design a product UI (glyph)

## Accepted inputs
A finished video or clean stills, and a few short titles.

## Deliverables
cover_A.jpg and siblings, plus ab_sheet.jpg.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Python 3.9+
- ffmpeg (on PATH or FFMPEG)

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

Local only.

None.

## Human decisions
- Which single variable changes between versions
- Which still is clean enough to carry type

## Quality checks
- Title is readable at thumbnail size
- Type does not cover the subject

## Common failures
- A frame grabbed from the finished video already has captions on it

## Limitations
- Title formulas in the method are written for short product videos
- Not run here
